name: 22951-random2k1k-gptoss20b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, one vLLM engine.
architecture: sparse mixture-of-experts decoder in bfloat16 -- 24 layers, 32 local experts with 4 active per token, alternating sliding-window (128) and full attention; ~41 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=10, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 300 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. Seed static 22538.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn: 2048 prompt tokens and 1024 output tokens per request, min == max on both, temperature 0, sent as plain text completions rather than through a chat template. Requests run to the full 1024 output tokens; EOS is not honoured.
purpose: A long-form drafting assistant on one H100, serving ten concurrent users 2,000-word prompts and 1,000-token replies.
launch:
model: unsloth/gpt-oss-20b-BF16
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# PINNED, AND LOAD-BEARING. Do not delete either as "the default": 8192 / 1024 is what a plain
# `vllm serve` resolves to on a >=70 GiB non-A100 card at this commit, and an in-process engine
# falls through to a smaller scheduler budget (2048 / 128) instead.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-chunked-prefill: true
enable-prefix-caching: true

# The workload's worst case is 2048 prompt + 1024 output = 3072 tokens. Without this the engine
# would take the checkpoint's full 131072.
max-model-len: 4096

# vLLM's own default here, written out so a change of default cannot move the KV pool.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
